name: Nix
description: Code intelligence for Nix files using nixd from your Nix installation.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings, inspect hover information, go to definitions and rename symbols in Nix files. Install nixd with Nix and make it available on PATH. This plugin uses your installed nixd version. The language server starts when you open a Nix file in a project and stops when none are open.
failed: The Nix language server could not start.
